idea-plugin.name: Terminal AI Watcher
idea-plugin.description:
Monitors Android Studio's built-in terminal for AI CLI tool events (Claude Code, Codex, Gemini CLI) and sends IDE notifications with system sounds.

macOS: To receive system notification banners, allow notifications for your IDE in System Settings → Notifications. (In-IDE balloon notifications work without this.)
idea-plugin.change-notes:
1.2.2

  • New: Open the originating terminal tab using the "Go to terminal tab" link in IDE notifications. Clicking a Windows system notification, or returning to the IDE shortly after an alert on macOS and Linux, also switches to the terminal. This behavior can be turned off under Notification Channels.
  • Improve: More reliable terminal tab names and navigation to the originating project window when several IDE windows are open.
  • Fix: Removed duplicate Codex approval notification registrations left by earlier automatic setup and restored missing Claude Code approval and completion handlers while preserving other integrations. Consecutive approval requests are no longer suppressed by the notification cooldown.
  • Fix: On Windows, an unavailable notification sound now falls back to an installed Windows sound, including when the saved setting still refers to a macOS sound.
  • Improve: Updated terminal integration for newer IDE releases, with compatibility verified on Android Studio 2026.1 and IntelliJ IDEA 2026.3 EAP.
